_readme: FROZEN test set: score once. Do not edit; evals/test_set.sha256 detects changes. Add your own questions in evals/test_set_user.json.

questions.question: What is the total net revenue?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE 1=1 UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE 1=1)
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID.

questions.question: How many orders were placed?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) FROM sales
questions.gold_definition: Orders = distinct invoice_no in sales (cancellation invoices not counted); includes no-ID rows.

questions.question: How many units were sold before returns in total?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM sales
questions.gold_definition: Units sold = SUM(sales.quantity), gross (returns not subtracted).

questions.question: What is the gross sales revenue before returns?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) FROM sales
questions.gold_definition: Gross sales revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) (GBP), before returns; includes rows without a CustomerID.

questions.question: How many different products have been sold?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stock_code) FROM sales
questions.gold_definition: Distinct stock_code in sales.

questions.question: What was the net revenue in March 2011?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-03-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-03-01', '+1 month') UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-03-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-03-01', '+1 month'))
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID. Month = calendar month of invoice_date.

questions.question: What is the net revenue for Germany?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE country = 'Germany' UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE country = 'Germany')
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID.

questions.question: What are the top 5 countries by net revenue, excluding the United Kingdom? Give the country and the value.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE country <> 'United Kingdom' UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE country <> 'United Kingdom') GROUP BY country ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID.

questions.question: How many units sold before returns were there of the product described as 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM sales WHERE description = 'WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER'
questions.gold_definition: Units = SUM(sales.quantity) where the description matches exactly (gross; stock code 85123A also has a second description).

questions.question: What was the net revenue between 2011-12-01 and 2011-12-09, inclusive?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2011-12-01' AND '2011-12-09' UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2011-12-01' AND '2011-12-09')
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID.

questions.question: How many orders were placed from France?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) FROM sales WHERE country = 'France'
questions.gold_definition: Distinct sales invoices with country France; includes no-ID rows.

questions.question: List the stock codes and units sold before returns of the 3 best-selling products in November 2011.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT stock_code, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-11-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-11-01', '+1 month') GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 3
questions.gold_definition: Units = SUM(sales.quantity) in November 2011, gross.

questions.question: What was the gross revenue from sales to the Netherlands in 2011?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) FROM sales WHERE country = 'Netherlands' AND invoice_date >= '2011-01-01'
questions.gold_definition: Gross sales revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) (GBP), before returns; includes rows without a CustomerID. Country = Netherlands, calendar year 2011.

questions.question: How many distinct customers have made a purchase?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1
questions.gold_definition: Distinct known customer_id in sales; has_customer_id = 1 only.

questions.question: How many customers placed more than 5 orders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) > 5)
questions.gold_definition: Known customers with more than 5 distinct sales invoices; has_customer_id = 1 only.

questions.question: List the customer IDs and net revenue of the top 5 customers by net revenue.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE has_customer_id = 1) GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue per customer = sales revenue - return value for that customer; only rows with has_customer_id = 1.

questions.question: What is the average number of orders per customer?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id || '|' || invoice_no) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 2) FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1
questions.gold_definition: Distinct (customer, sales invoice) pairs / distinct known customers; has_customer_id = 1 only.

questions.question: How many customers are in Germany?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 AND country = 'Germany'
questions.gold_definition: Distinct known customer_id in sales rows with country Germany (8 customers appear under more than one country).

questions.question: What percentage of sales lines have no customer ID?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_customer_id = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM sales
questions.gold_definition: Share of sales rows with has_customer_id = 0, in percent, rounded to 2 decimals.

questions.question: What is the total value of returns?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(return_value), 2) FROM returns
questions.gold_definition: Return value = SUM(returns.return_value), positive GBP; includes no-ID rows.

questions.question: How many return lines are there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns
questions.gold_definition: Count of rows in returns.

questions.question: Which product has the highest return value? Give the stock code and the value.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT stock_code, ROUND(SUM(return_value), 2) AS return_value FROM returns GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY return_value DESC LIMIT 1
questions.gold_definition: Return value per stock_code; top 1. (23843 is the huge cancelled order.)

questions.question: Which country has the highest return value? Give the country and the value.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(return_value), 2) AS return_value FROM returns GROUP BY country ORDER BY return_value DESC LIMIT 1
questions.gold_definition: Return value per country; top 1.

questions.question: By what percentage did net revenue change from October 2011 to November 2011?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-11-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-11-01', '+1 month') UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-11-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-11-01', '+1 month'))) - (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-10-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-10-01', '+1 month') UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-10-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-10-01', '+1 month')))) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-10-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-10-01', '+1 month') UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-10-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-10-01', '+1 month'))), 2)
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID. Percentage = (November - October) / October x 100, rounded to 2 decimals.

questions.question: Which month had the highest net revenue? Give the month and the value.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month FROM sales WHERE 1=1 UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month FROM returns WHERE 1=1) GROUP BY month ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID. Month = strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date).

questions.question: Between January and November 2011, which month had the lowest net revenue? Give the month and the value.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-12-01' UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, strftime('%Y-%m', invoice_date) AS month FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-12-01') GROUP BY month ORDER BY net_revenue ASC LIMIT 1
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID. Months 2011-01 to 2011-11 only.

questions.question: By what percentage did gross revenue change from Q1 2011 (January to March) to Q2 2011 (April to June)?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ((SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-04-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-07-01') - (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-04-01')) / (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoice_date < '2011-04-01'), 2)
questions.gold_definition: Gross sales revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) (GBP), before returns; includes rows without a CustomerID. Percentage = (Q2 - Q1) / Q1 x 100, rounded to 2 decimals.
